title: Graduate civil engineer - Engineering Development Program expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Beveridge Williams careers page (read 4 Oct 2026 AEDT): We're always on the lookout for ambitious, creative people to join our growing team. Engineering Development Program: Real projects from day one; Structured development program with dedicated mentors; Become a well-rounded civil consulting professional. Professional Development: We are committed to supporting your ongoing professional development from graduate level through to experienced business leader. We want to hear from you. Email: melbourne@bevwill.com.au. Phone: (03) 9524 8888. Office: 1 Glenferrie Road (PO Box 61), Malvern VIC 3144.
Work spans multidisciplinary civil consulting including land development and infrastructure; graduate program testimonials describe infrastructure team mentoring, subdivision and growth-area projects, and flexible graduate trajectory.
apply_instructions: Email expression of interest with CV to melbourne@bevwill.com.au (published on careers page).
